# Collect. Mutate. Trade. Rebirth!
[media]
**😎 Become an OG, Join Discord:** https://discord.gg/nomsters

Step into the charming, cozy world of Nomsters, the ultimate relaxing creature-collector in VR! Gather adorable companions, build your dream team, and take them along as you explore and grow together. Whether you’re a casual collector or a completionist, there’s always a new Nomster waiting to be found!

# Key Features
🐾 **Collect & Mutate**: Discover dozens of unique Nomsters across various rarities. Experiment with mutations to unlock rare, powerful forms, and build the ultimate companion group to take out into the world.

🤝 **Trade with Friends**: Got duplicates or hunting for that missing Nomster? Trade with other players to complete your collection!

⛏️ **Fun Game Modes**: Put your Nomsters to work! Send your companions into Mining to gather valuable resources, or jump into Defense mode to ward off incoming threats and earn exclusive rewards.

🔄 **Rebirth & Grow**: Power up through the Rebirth system. Reset your progress to unlock new abilities, boost your stats, and upgrade your home base!

**Ready to meet your new best friends?**
